rationale: Glucose and arabinose are abundant and readily fermented. Arginine provides supplemental nitrogen and carbon. Lactate can be consumed and re-fermented. At 0.45 /h growth, carbon and nitrogen budgets balance: 23 mmol C in minus 17.1 mmol biomass cost leaves 5.9 mmol for fermentation products (acetate, lactate, CO₂). Nitrogen: 7 mmol in, 4.5 mmol biomass cost, 2.5 mmol excess released as NH₄⁺.
